items: SOFT, STRONG & STRETCHY - Biostretch Garden Plant Ties are made from premium green fabric that is soft, strong, and stretchy. Reduce waste by easily cutting to your desired length and provide support for your delicate indoor and outdoor plants.

GENTLE GROWING SUPPORT - Ideal for houseplants, climbing plants, tomato vines, and young trees, Biostretch green garden ties stretch with growth to prevent damage often caused by rigid plastic ties or wire, ensuring healthy development without ring barking or constriction.

NATURALLY DEGRADES - After 18-24 months of outdoor use, Biostretch plant ties start to naturally degrade and fall to the ground. Made from 95% natural materials, Biostretch is one of the most environmentally friendly garden plant ties on the market; simply collect any remaining remnants for a 100% organic garden or compost.

VERSATILE & EASY TO USE - Ideal for various gardening and home projects, Biostretch plant tape is simple to apply, reposition, and remove, providing secure, gentle support for delicate plants when used with bamboo canes, garden stakes, wire trellises, or climbing frame supports.

ORIGINAL DESIGN & TRUSTED QUALITY - As the original award-winning eco-friendly garden twine and plant string, Biostretch has been trusted by both professional and home gardeners since 2012, and earned a Which? Test Score of 94%, reflecting its exceptional quality, reliability, and safe support that grows with your plants.
